messages:
ana: Hey @people-ops — heads up: theres a transit strike today affecting my commute. I can only make it in for a half day but were in the Dec 20-31 blackout. Is there a way to swap hours or get a PTO advance for the afternoon?
lee (People Ops): Sorry about the strike, Ana. We allow emergency exceptions during blackout on a case-by-case basis. Two quick things: 1) manager sign-off needed, 2) payroll cutoff matters if you want an advance.
nana: I already pinged Toni (my manager) and she replied "ok to cover" but asked to follow the exception form.
toni: Confirming I approve Ana for a half-day off today (coverage arranged). Can People Ops process as PTO advance if payroll allows?
lee (People Ops): Thanks Toni. Ana we need you to pick one: 1) use PTO balance (consumes hours), 2) PTO advance (requires manager + People Ops + payroll), 3) unpaid for the afternoon. If payroll cutoff for this pay period passed (Dec 18 5pm PT) advances may not show until next cycle and could be processed retroactively.
nana: I don't want unpaid. Please put as PTO advance if possible.
lee (People Ops): Filing exception now. Please paste manager approval into the form comments: https://forms.company/blackout-exception. Subject template: "Blackout Exception  Ana Lopez  Dec 23 half day (transit)".
payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff = Dec 18 17:00 PT. After cutoff, PTO advances are queued for next cycle and may require retro pay. See https://payroll.company/cutoffs.
logan: Quick ops note: team rota updated, coverage confirmed for afternoon on-call.
lee (People Ops): Ana  once you submit the form Ill route to payroll. If payroll cant process an advance this cycle we can tentatively mark as unpaid and then post-payroll adjust to PTO advance once approved. Which do you prefer?
nana: Please tentatively mark unpaid and then adjust to PTO advance once you confirm with payroll. I don't want any blocker on the on-call coverage.
lee (People Ops): Got it. Submitted exception #BX-5178 (tentative unpaid -> retro adjust to PTO advance). Routing to payroll now. Expect response within 24 business hours.
toni: Thanks everyone. Ana DM me the handoff notes.
payroll-bot: Exception #BX-5178 received. Routing to payroll (pending).
lee (People Ops): Ana: final note on carryover: doing a PTO advance doesn't change your carryover rules. If you need to preserve year-end balance reach out early next year for a carryover review.
nana: Thanks y'all  appreciate the fast turnaround :heart:
